description: This file defines register offsets, macros, data structures, and function prototypes for flash memory operations on the MPC55xx architecture, specifically for the C90FL flash controller.

methods.name: FSL_FlashProgramStart
methods.description: Starts flash programming operation at specified register base with destination, size, and source pointers.

methods.name: FSL_FlashEraseStart
methods.description: Initiates flash erase operation with specified block configuration.

methods.name: FSL_FlashCheckStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the flash operation.

methods.name: FSL_DataVerify
methods.description: Verifies data in flash, optionally performing a blank check, with callback support.

methods.name: FSL_FlashRead
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory with callback support.

methods.name: FSL_FlashEraseAbort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing flash erase operation.

methods.name: FSL_SearchRecordInBlock
methods.description: Searches for a record within a flash block based on ID.

methods.name: FSL_FlashRead8
methods.description: Reads a byte from flash at specified address.

methods.name: FSL_FlashRead64
methods.description: Reads 64 bits from flash at specified address.

methods.name: FSL_ReadRecordHead
methods.description: Reads the header of a data record from flash.
